interview:
Honest summary: **I did not win.** The session ended before Le Chonk reached the fish.

What happened:
- I started the game successfully by typing "Player" and pressing Play. The board loaded as a 7×7 grid with the orange cat at bottom-left, the blue fish at top-right, a dark guard dog near the middle, and several X obstacle squares.
- I made a series of moves trying to navigate the cat toward the fish while keeping distance from the dog — moving up and right along open squares.
- At one point I mistakenly clicked the "Play again" button at the bottom of the screen, which restarted the game and reset the board (the cat went back to the start).
- In the restarted game I made 2 moves: up one square, then right along the bottom row. The dog stayed a few rows behind me, and the X obstacles were between us.
- The session then ended with the cat at the bottom row, second column — still far from the fish at the top-right corner, with "Moves: 2" shown.

So the outcome was a draw in the sense that I neither won nor was caught — I simply ran out of session time mid-game. My strategy was sound (hugging the bottom row to keep the dog at a distance behind the obstacle line), but I didn't get far enough to reach the fish before the session ended.
